bio.text: Emanuel Jones, a Democrat, has represented Georgia's 10th Senate District, which includes southwest DeKalb and Henry counties, since his election in 2004.
Jones is president of Legacy Automotive Group, founded in 1993, and earlier held positions at IBM and Arthur Andersen.
Jones earned an MBA from Columbia University in 1986 and a BS in Electrical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania in 1981, and was commissioned in the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers in 1980.
